children: Overview
China steel processor's H1 revenue rose 3.3% yr/yr
Net profit for H1 increased 49.5% yr/yr
Company diluted stake in Chongqing Daming to 65% via connected transaction
Outlook
Group expects adequate liquidity to meet obligations and continue operations for at least 12 months from period-end
Result Drivers
SEGMENT MIX - Revenue growth was mainly driven by increased sales in specialized machinery and petrochemical equipment segments
CARBON STEEL THROUGHPUT – Carbon-steel processing volume rose 2.4% to 2.50 mln tonnes, indicating higher processing activity
LOWER ADMINISTRATIVE COSTS – Administrative expenses fell to RMB154.1 mln from RMB184.6 mln, mainly due to lower entertainment and travelling expenses
